title: WordPress Categories Config
description: Source-of-truth config for a project's WordPress blog category taxonomy. Applied by scripts/wordpress/setup_categories.py.

site_slug.description: Project slug. Must match projects/{slug}/ directory name and WP credentials filename.

generated_at.description: ISO date when this config was last edited.

_design_notes.description: Optional editorial commentary for human readers; not used by the script.

slug.description: Globally-unique WordPress category slug. Use parent-prefixed naming (e.g. 'lighting-buyer-guides') to avoid global collision.

name.description: Display name shown in WP admin, breadcrumbs, and menus. Can repeat across parents (e.g. 'Buyer Guides' under both Lighting and Climate Control) — only the slug must be unique.

oneOf.description: Slug of the parent category. The setup script resolves this to the WP integer ID at apply time.

description.description: Plain-prose description shown on the archive page above the post grid. 35-80 words. NO HTML, NO inline links, NO inside-baseball language. See subskills/init/wordpress-category-setup/references/category-description-style-guide.md.

rank_math_title.description: SEO title for the archive page. 50-60 chars (Google display limit ~60). Format: '{Category Name}: {Differentiating Phrase} | {Brand Name}'.

rank_math_description.description: Meta description for the archive page. 150-160 chars max. Focus keyword in first 120 chars.

rank_math_focus_keyword.description: Comma-separated focus keywords (1-3) that this archive page targets. First keyword should appear in title + description + first sentence of description body.

rank_math_robots.description: Robots directives for the archive page. Almost always ['index']. 'follow' is NOT a valid enum member; use 'index' (follow is implicit).

rank_math_canonical_url.description: Optional. Override canonical URL. Default = the archive URL itself.

$comment.description: Optional editorial comment for human readers.
